VIDEO SCRIPT: NICODEMUS’ ENCOUNTER WITH JESUS CHRIST
Grade: Grade 4 · Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION

[0:00–0:20] HOOK
• Host: “Today we learn Nicodemus’ encounter with Jesus Christ. Watch the example, then you try.”

[0:20–2:00] TEACH
• retell the story of Nicodemus’ encounter with Jesus Christ
• discuss the importance of baptism to Christians today
• recite John 3:16 and believe in Jesus Christ to inherit eternal life

[2:00–4:00] WORKED EXAMPLE ON SCREEN
• Model 1: retell the story of Nicodemus’ encounter with Jesus Christ
• Model 2: discuss the importance of baptism to Christians today
• Model 3: recite John 3:16 and believe in Jesus Christ to inherit eternal life

[4:00–5:00] TRY THIS (PAUSE)
• Practise: retell the story of Nicodemus’ encounter with Jesus Christ
• Practise: discuss the importance of baptism to Christians today
• Practise: recite John 3:16 and believe in Jesus Christ to inherit eternal life

[5:00–5:30] REMEMBER + CTA
• Recap 3 bullets. “Now open Revision Quiz for Nicodemus’ encounter with Jesus Christ.”

— CBC Learn · Video Hub script aligned to lesson + revision
